[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)

- Description: AGL14 serialization + QR-sheet header-contract guard (thread 25671)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/10
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets/pull/11

  Details:
  Work executed for Gary Teh, thread 25671 — Agroverse QR-sheet provenance chain.
  
  DELIVERED
  1. 40 AGL14 QR codes (2024OSCAR_AGL14_20260911_1..40) were present in the sheet but never pushed down the sheet -> manifest -> index chain, so they were invisible on truesight.me/physical-assets/serialized. Seeded 40 manifests + rebuilt qrs_index.json (1,776 -> 1,820 rows). LIVE verified: page HTTP 200, 40/40 rows resolve, 0 with wrong status/farm.
  
  2. Root-caused a silent-clobber defect: seed_from_sheet.py reads seedling_photo_url from col R (Tree Seedling Photo URL) but 101 FounderHaus CT_20260820_* rows carried the photo in col S (Product Image) -- which build_lineage() ignores entirely, and merge_preserve_events() preserves custom events only, never lineage fields. Blast radius: 101 manifests would silently lose their photo on any full re-seed. Fixed per Gary's direction by writing the value into col R (101 cells), then proved a full sheet-wide re-seed: 104 photo-bearing manifests kept, 0 lost.
  
  3. Header-contract audit (Gary's ask: "row 1 columns which indicate the header values -- other GAS, Python and LLMs rely on the value being correct"). Row 1 IS fully populated (28/28, no blanks/dups). The real risk is the CONTRACT: every consumer addresses the sheet POSITIONALLY (manifest.py COL map, process_qr_code_updates.gs *_COL_DEST, sales scripts, stripe_sales_sync.js); only newsletter_subscriber_sync.js resolves by name. An inserted/reordered column would silently write the wrong field into the ledger.
  
  4. Shipped a guard in seed_from_sheet.py: EXPECTED_HEADERS (28 cols per tokenomics/SCHEMA.md), whitespace+case normalizing validator, pre-read check that exits 1 with a per-column diff, plus --allow-header-drift. Verified passes on the live sheet and fires on column insert / swap / rename / blank / trailing-add. Normalization does not false-positive on the four headers that legitimately carry embedded newlines (M, N, U, W).
  
  Change set was deliberately scoped: excluded a re-seed that would have dropped an Edgar-SIGNED events[1] (signed_by + sig_ref) on FOUNDERHAUS_BOUGAINVILLEA_20260821_1, and 2 stale TEST_AGL4 row creations.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - lineage-assets #10 (merged) - 40 AGL14 manifests + index rebuild + 101-cell photo round-trip fix
  - lineage-assets #11 (merged) - QR-sheet header-contract guard
  - agentic_ai_context #1045 (merged) - 3 follow-ups filed under OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md ## Pending
